clip_texts: SC-15 Kerbside stop while passengers board or alight

The vehicle pulls in to a mapped stop, passengers get in and out, including slowly or with help, and the vehicle pulls
out; a person may stand behind it

One concrete scenario (seeded sample of the logical
scenario)
ODD-20 Ego speed: 12.3 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)
ODD-09 Stopping places: kerbside-stop
ODD-16 Traffic participants: pedestrian
ODD-06 Road surface and geometry: 1.7 % (range 0 to 8 %)

Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033);
choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
Safety goals at stake

SG-05 (ASIL D): Avoid unintended motion from standstill, forward
or backward
Pass criterion

The vehicle does not move with a door open or a person in the near
field in the direction of travel, never reverses, and resumes only
when every release condition holds (FSR-05.01, FSR-05.03,
FSR-05.05, FSR-07.04, HR-04)
Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
Meant to do: holds while a door is open
Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
Where the hazard lies: HE-05.1 Moves off while a passenger is boarding or alighting; HE-10.1 Reverses into a person behind the vehicle at a kerbside stop
Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about
